purpose: Provide a deterministic conservative preflight that detects provable local conflicts among exact-match projected translation constraints, same-body-pair center-distance equalities/ranges, and the bounded same-pair case where one required projection magnitude exceeds a finite center-distance maximum.

properties.constraints: existing seven-family UC constraint set: translation mounts, distance joints/limits, axis locks/limits and fixed-direction locks/limits

limitations: conservative local projected-translation and same-pair radial-distance checks only, plus a bounded same-pair proof when one projection interval alone requires more distance than a finite radial maximum allows
the coupled proof uses only |projection| <= center distance and does not combine multiple independent projected directions
radial minima do not by themselves conflict with one projected interval because perpendicular freedom may satisfy them
does not prove global satisfiability, convergence, stability or physical correctness
distance reasoning does not span triangles, loops, multi-pair geometry or other coupled constraints beyond the stated same-pair upper-bound proof
near-parallel but non-identical directions are intentionally not merged
disabled analyzed constraints are validated but excluded from conflict intersections
does not change solver order, world state, collision behavior or donor source

proves: translation mounts conflict-check against aligned axis locks
axis and scaled fixed-direction constraints share an exact normalized projection group
same-pair distance equality/range intersections can prove compatible and contradictory radial intervals
a same-pair required projection magnitude above a finite radial maximum is conservatively rejected
a projected range containing zero remains compatible with a smaller radial maximum because the preflight uses the minimum required projection magnitude
radial minimum alone is not falsely treated as a projected contradiction
disabled conflicting constraints remain inert while invalid references still fail validation
bounded tolerance applies to projected, radial and projection/radial upper-bound separation
same-runtime report checksum replay is deterministic

truth.basis: Only contradictions proven by exact interval intersection or the necessary inequality |projection| <= center distance on the exact same body pair are reported; stronger coupled geometry remains an explicit non-claim.

agency.basis: The preflight remains advisory evidence and does not silently mutate constraints or force a repair.

continuity.basis: It reuses existing seven-family normalizers and leaves the byte-for-byte donor physics source and solver behavior unchanged.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: It catches an additional class of locally impossible same-pair constraints before callers spend bounded solver passes on them.
